messages:
nguyen: pushed a tiny Next.js starter that wires LlamaIndex retrieval -> LangChain agent -> Redwood SDK. It's meant to show SSR previews for content. Getting auth failures only on first SSR render in our prod-sim env. anyone familiar with this pattern?

zoe: repo/link? curious what env vars you expect.

nguyen: https://github.com/redwood-inference/next-ssr-starter
Repro: clone, yarn, cp .env.example .env.local, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, yarn dev, visit /preview/first-article. client fetches after hydration succeed but server render returns 401 once.

patrick: which sdk version in package.json? serverless or edge target?

nguyen: @patrick sdk @ 2.4.1, next target = server (not edge). Logs on the server lambda: 
```
WARN Redwood SDK: attempting ephemeral token exchange for session cookie
ERROR /preview/first-article 401 Unauthorized - token exchange failed: no session cookie found
    at getToken (/workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/token.js:78:15)
    at handleRequest (/workspace/pages/api/_preview.js:23:7)
```
Note: subsequent client requests (XHR) show 200 with same API key.

morgan: this smells like parity between cookie-first and service-key flows. SSR run (CI/preview lambda) doesn't have cookies so the SDK should fallback to env service key if present. Do you have REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY set?

nguyen: not in the .env.local—they only have REDWOOD_API_KEY from the quickstart. was expecting the SDK to fallback to ephemeral exchange->service automatically.

zoe: related: i've hit retry storms during prefetch where batching enabled + SSR triggers 429s. The server loop retries aggressively because the retry policy assumes client latency budget. For SSR we need shorter retry cap + exponential backoff + jitter.

patrick: agree. short-term fixes: 1) in the starter README call out REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY for local SSR/dev; 2) set SDK_RETRY_MAX=3 and SDK_RETRY_BACKOFF=exponential in server preview config; 3) consider disabling continuous batching for the SSR route to avoid request pileups.

morgan: filing an SDK bug: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/913 - title: "server fallback: service key should be used when no session cookie available during SSR". adding logs and repro. assigning to eng-runtime.

devx-bot: noted. issue 913 created, linked to PR template for SDK.

zoe: we should add a tiny playwright smoke to the starter's CI that hits the SSR preview URL and asserts 200 on first load. catches regressions in token-exchange / retry. can add as a separate job with a mock service key.

nguyen: i'll open a PR with: README patch, example .env.local showing REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY comment, default SDK_RETRY_MAX override for server routes, and a CI smoke test using playwright. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/next-ssr-starter/pull/6 (WIP) :sparkles:

ci-bot: buildkite: pipeline for branch next-ssr-starter - smoke tests failed on ephemeral infra (flaky).

patrick: for the SDK fix, we should also add a unit test that mocks absence of cookie and asserts fallback to service key; help avoid future parity regressions between edge/server clients.

morgan: noted: adding integration test in eng-runtime that runs against a local Next dev server and asserts request path taken uses service key flow when REDWOOD_SERVICE_KEY env var present.

nguyen: thanks all. will tidy up PR and mark it ready for review once CI is less flaky. will ping in thread when green. :thumbsup:
